Although memory costs are expected to easily become the single largest expense on the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here's what you need to know.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said in a post on Weibo today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for folding panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of folding panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also noted that this is, unsurprisingly, "one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

While no reliable information about the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo has surfaced yet, teardowns breaking down the costs of displays, cameras, processors, memory, and other components will give us a clearer picture of what goes into making the device after Apple shares interesting information about its manufacturing materials, including how much recycled content it contains.
